name: Pocket Clone
tagline: Warm paper reading room: cream page, ink text, one terracotta accent, Fraunces serif titles over Source Sans 3
constraints: Light only: cream page (#FAF7F2) with a faint terracotta paper texture, warm-white (#FFFDFB) surfaces, cream-dark (#F0EBE3) for every border, divider and quiet fill. Terracotta (#C85A3B) is the single accent: primary buttons, the active nav row, selected options, focus rings, card-title hover; terracotta-soft is its hover. Fraunces carries titles only (page title, card titles, sheet and empty-state headings, the 56px login hero at weight 300); Source Sans 3 carries everything else. Resting surfaces are flat with a 1px (fields 1.5px) cream-dark border; shadows appear only on hover lift and on floating menus. Three radii: 6px (rows, chips, small buttons, thumbnails), 10px (fields, primary buttons, cards, menus, count pills), 14px (bottom-sheet top corners). One breakpoint at 768px: below it the sidebar becomes a filter button plus a bottom sheet, the URL form stacks with a full-width button, card dates and chip labels hide, delete shows without hover. No status colours beyond danger; no icon package (inline 24-grid stroke icons).
